summary.headline: Review of the nature words and the question/game words, each in a sentence with the tool words

rules.title: مفضل is an adjective: el-noun el-mufaddal 3indi
bullets: مفضل comes after the noun and agrees with it
with the pronoun on the noun: بوظتي المفضلة

examples.line: el-buza el-mufaddala 3indi - ice cream is my favorite
hadoal el-musalsalaat el-mufaddaleen 3indi - these shows are my favorite
بوظتي المفضلة cookie dough - my favorite ice cream is cookie dough
el-jbaal el-mufaddalleen 3indi - mountains are my favorite

rules.title: taani before the noun = another; el-noun el-taani = the other / the second
rules.pattern: noun + taani = another  /  el-noun + el-taani = the other
bullets: noun taani (no el-) = another, a different one
el-noun el-taani = the other or the second, from context
kamaan = more of the same; taani = a different one

examples.line: el-bu7ayra el-taanie btebse6 aktar - the other lake is more fun
e7na bne2dar nroo7 3ala sha66 taani - we can go to another beach
ana ba7taaj kamaan wara2a - I need one more paper
3indek su2aal taani / kamaan su2aal - do you have another question?
biddi lu3be taanie - I want another game

rules.title: awal / aa5er + noun = first / last; aa5er + el-noun = the end of
rules.pattern: awal + noun  =  noun-i + el-oola;  aa5er + noun  =  noun-i + el-a5eer
bullets: awal and aa5er go before the noun with no el-
after the noun use the adjective: el-oola, el-a5eer(a)
aa5er su2aali = the end of my question, not my last question
aa5er is its own noun: aa5er el-lu3be kaan (masculine)

examples.line: haadi el-8aabe awal wa7de baroo7 3alaiha - this forest is the first one I go to
2aa5er su2aali = the end of my question
su2aali el-a5eer / aa5er su2aal ili - my last question
haadi lu3beti el-oola / awal lu3be ili - this is my first game
aa5er el-lu3be kaan beyzahhe2 - the end of the game was boring

rules.title: 8eir before the noun never takes el-; mu5talif is an adjective after it; nafs + el-noun
bullets: مختلف follows the noun: نوع مختلف, أنواع مختلفين
nafs always takes el- on the noun

examples.line: haada 8eir noa3 min el-shajar - that is a different type of trees
ana jarrabet anwaa3 mu5talefeen min el-akel - I tried different types of food
ana ba7taaj 8eir wara2a / wara2a taanie - I need a different paper
hada nafs el-manzar illi shufto fi Madrid - this is the same view I saw in Madrid
ektub esmek 3ala nafs el-wara2a - write your name on the same paper

rules.title: a8lab + el-plural = most of; a8lab + plural-i = most of my

examples.line: a8lab el-byoot fi Amrica fihom 7asheesh - most houses in America have grass
a8lab as2ilti muhemmeen - most of my questions are important
a8lab el-al3aab hoan r5aas - most of the games here are cheap
